title: Unique descent isomorphism with the explicit chart tensor-pullback comparisons
statement: Let U be an open cover of a scheme X [def-pc-scheme], q:Y → X a morphism, and M an O_X-module [def-pc-module-pullback]. Let D be the canonical descent datum of M on U pulled to the base-changed charts, and E the canonical datum on those charts of the tensor pullback of M. There is exactly one descent isomorphism D ≅ E whose hom and inverse chart components are respectively the hom and inverse components of openCoverTensorPullbackComparison [def-pc-open-cover-tensor-pullback-comparison]. These fixed chart maps determine all its data, up to equality of isomorphisms. No hypothesis on q, the modules or the overlaps is required.

source.place: Tags 0095 and 0096; canonical pullback composition and unique left-adjoint comparison; Mathlib DescentData.toDescentDataCompPullFunctorIso

proof.text: Compose the canonical toDescentDataCompPullFunctorIso with the canonical descent functor applied to the unique comparison of the native and tensor left adjoints to pushforward. This constructs an isomorphism of the two specified descent data.

Its chart component is inverse isoMapOfCommSq for the chart square followed by restriction of the unique left-adjoint comparison. Expand isoMapOfCommSq_eq. The modulesPseudofunctor_mapComp'_hom_app_eq and modulesPseudofunctor_mapComp'_inv_app_eq equations give pullbackComp, pullbackCongr for the chart-square equality, and inverse pullbackComp. These are exactly the first three factors of openCoverTensorPullbackComparison; the restricted adjoint comparison is its fourth factor. Check the component equality using functor composition and associativity.

The constructed canonical isomorphism has the prescribed hom components. Cancel each invertible chart hom to get its prescribed inverse component. Any two such isomorphisms have equal hom chart components; descent Hom extensionality makes their hom morphisms equal, and Iso.ext makes the isomorphisms equal. Hence the characterization determines all data uniquely. The construction and uniqueness include empty covers, zero modules and identity maps.

lean.statement:
theorem openCoverTensorDescentComparison_existsUnique
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (U : X.OpenCover.{u}) (q : Y ⟶ X) (M : X.Modules) :
    let D := (Pseudofunctor.DescentData.pullFunctor modulesPseudofunctor
      (f := U.f) (f' := fun x ↦ pullback.fst q (U.f x)) (p := q) (α := id)
      (p' := fun x ↦ U.pullbackHom q x) (fun x ↦ U.pullbackHom_map q x)).obj
      ((modulesPseudofunctor.toDescentData U.f).obj M)
    let E := (modulesPseudofunctor.toDescentData
      (fun x ↦ pullback.fst q (U.f x))).obj ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback q).obj M)
    ∃! e : D ≅ E, ∀ a : U.I₀,
      e.hom.hom a = (Scheme.Modules.openCoverTensorPullbackComparison q U a).hom.app M ∧
      e.inv.hom a = (Scheme.Modules.openCoverTensorPullbackComparison q U a).inv.app M
